title: AI-143 decision adapter output envelope
description: Common adapter protocol ai-lab-decision-adapter 1.0.0, framing json-line-v1: exactly one output envelope, the whole of the adapter's stdout, as one compact UTF-8 JSON line. result is the exact AI-140 typed decision result (no competing result shape); result_hash must equal result.result_hash and its AI-140 recomputation. Execution id, request hash and result-to-request binding are enforced by src/decision-sandbox/validation.ts. A valid output is sandbox output, not approved intelligence: downstream_allowed stays false inside the result.
